title: [Prime] INIU 45W 10000mAh Power Bank $19.17 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] INIU 45W 10000mAh Power Bank $19.17 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[greennick] Didn't need more, but bought 2 as I lose one every 3 months anyway
[tight 10000] these are absolute rubbish. They breaker a couple of months after buying them and then you can’t return them to amazon.
[xyzzyxyzzy] Make a complaint to their customer service, and get refund. 100% guaranteed.
[JamesLucas] Yep. Must be too expensive to obtain. The better outcome would be China accepting devices with CE etc compliance. Their policy is to stop cheap locally produced rubbish ending up on domestic flights, so it should be "CCC stamp, or must have CE, etc" but then I guess they expect fake stamps to appear and no-one locally is brave enough to fake a CCC.
[iLikePizza] Yeah these were confiscated at the china airport for me
[WavyClock] Not all time low, still a decent discount
[spaij] Cancel the anker power bank order from yesterday!
Don't forget TopCashback upsized CB
[salekhard] These inbuilt cables are a worry. Built in obsolescence?
[philbobaggins] Finally got one! This is perfect for the Mrs. Now waiting for a 20,000 for me!
[Big-Deal] Why this when similar is regularly much cheaper
[Meg4] Not sure about the performance of this specific power bank but those tiny ones definitely don't have a sustained 45w charge.
[lawyerz] I've got two of the tiny ones, they are just as fast as my Xiaomi Zmi No.20 210W 25000mah so I can't agree here
[MelbBoy] Shows at $37.59 for me even at checkout?
